rule_title: TTP 1543.003 - Encoded PowerShell Payload Deployed via Service Installation
description: Detects a service installed with a ServiceFileName containing an encoded or compressed PowerShell payload — the Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, and custom stager pattern. Key indicators are -EncodedCommand/-enc, Base64 strings, GzipStream, or MemoryStream in the service binary path. Covers both EID 4697 (Security) and 7045 (System).
